title: Fire at Starlink Center in Lithuania Was Sabotage, Officials Say
summary_full: The fire, which did not seriously damage the network, came after similar incidents in Bulgaria and Poland involving the satellite internet provider, a key defense tool for Ukraine’s armed forces.
